timeline.why: Kane read the prices: the product page showed €49.00 and the checkout total was €53.99. The checkout listed Service fee — 4.99. Apart from shipping and tax, 4.99 more than the shown price was added at checkout (Service fee —).

A cookie banner appeared and all cookies were rejected.

The checkout total is €53.99, including a Service fee of €4.99.

timeline.summary:
Problem: `server.js` added a €4.99 "Service fee" only at checkout, so the €49.00 product price turned into €53.99 at the last step.

Fix: I removed the hidden fee (the `SERVICE_FEE` constant and its checkout line), so checkout now totals €49.00, the same as the product page and cart. `node --check` passes; I haven't re-run the Kane check.

timeline.why: Kane read the prices: the product page showed €49.00 and the checkout total was €49.00. Apart from shipping and tax, the shopper pays the price they were shown.
